Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division of the Ministry of Finance is identified as the issuing authority for this notification under the laws of Bangladesh.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance serves as the parent government body under which the Internal Resources Division exercises its regulatory functions.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act empowers the Government to issue notifications regarding customs duty adjustments in the public interest, following consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to amend tax-related notifications in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Government is mandated to consult with this board before exercising its powers to amend customs and tax notifications.
TABLE: The table within the specified previous notification is being amended to update the description and classification of goods.
H.S. Code: The entry for the specified H.S. Code under heading 85.32 is replaced with a new code and description to accurately reflect the goods classified as capacitors.
